Case
files.

FIG. 01 — Screened oat line with elevated avenanthramide, mid-germination
CASE 01 · CROPTAILOR AB · PROCESS OPTIMISATION

Germination, under control.

Avenanthramide is an antioxidant found only in oats. By treating germination as a controllable process, tuning temperature and time and optimising the assays used to measure it, the output rose far beyond the baseline.

INPUTS
Temperature, time
OUTPUT
Avenanthramide conc.
RESULT
12–15× increase
CASE 02 · CROPTAILOR AB · SCREENING & STATISTICS

From mutant library to market.

Screening and phenotyping mutagenised oat lines for higher dietary fibre (arabinoxylan and β-glucan), across greenhouse and field trials with statistical and qualitative analysis. The work contributed to a high β-glucan oat variety released on the Swedish market, and to two peer-reviewed papers.

Represented CropTailor as a speaker on Nordic oat cultivation and breeding at the MarketsandMarkets Next-Gen AgriTech Conference, Chicago, 2022.

Sample collection Phenotyping Trial design Statistical analysis Reporting

CASE 03 · PHD, UNIVERSITY OF BORÅS · DESIGN OF EXPERIMENTS

Bacteria do the dirty work.

Less than 2% of critical battery metals are recycled today. My research trains Acidithiobacillus ferrooxidans to leach lithium, cobalt, nickel and manganese from spent batteries. I use statistical design of experiments to optimise the process for efficiency and sustainability.

Central composite design Growth kinetics Redox monitoring GLP
CASE 04 · NORTHVOLT ETT · INDUSTRIAL QC

Lab speed, factory stakes.

Quality control in a battery gigafactory, where every sample gates production. Chemical analysis against quality standards, traceable reporting in LabWare LIMS, and keeping instruments and people ready.

→Site XRD trainer, equipping operators to run and interpret analyses
→Reviewed and supervised training of lab support staff
